name: io.github.Toraastrta/sphior-ai-governance-mcp
description: Let your AI agent record its own executions as tamper-evident, independently verifiable evidence (hash-only) for ISO 42001 / EU AI Act / SOC 2.

environmentVariables.name: SPHIOR_AIGOV_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Ingestion token for your SPHIOR account. Without it the server still starts and tells you how to create one; no events are recorded until it is set. Create one at https://sphior.com/app?settings=aigov

environmentVariables.name: SPHIOR_AIGOV_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Override the ingestion endpoint for self-hosted / regional deployments. Default: https://sphior.com/api/ai-governance/ingest
